reviews.review: I really really wanted to like this game. The art is adorable and the mechanics are unique. Sadly it seems like the devs are not interested in updating it or answering questions/addressing game play issues. There are a number of bugs (half the menus just display ???) and despite getting perfects on every level you never seem to get enough money to accomplish anything. I had to switch from controller to mouse + keyboard because the controller controls were so poor. Keep that in mind if you plan to play on steamdeck. Specifically you need to move the left joystick to move the tray and the right joystick to move the hand. But moving the left joystick also runs through the menu at the top. So often times you're selecting the wrong things. The only updates from the devs are posting about sales and promotions. If the devs get around to responding to people and making adjustments (it's been out a month now with no patches and no responses to anyone) then I'll happily purchase again. For now I am sadly asking for a refund as I find the game unplayable.
